senses.gloss: a well-cultivated plot; whence (sub. גרש) (grist of) early ripened and tender barley.
units: <cite ref="Menachot 66b:7">Men. 66ᵇ</cite>; Sifra Vayikra, N’dabah, ch. XIV, Par. 13 (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 2:14">Lev. II, 14</cite>). <he>כ̇ר̇מ̇ל̇ ר̇ך̇ ומ̇ל̇</he> soft yet brittle; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 1:1:24">Y. Sabb. I, 2ᵈ</cite> bot. [read:] <he>רך מל לא לח וכ׳</he> soft yet brittle, neither green nor dry, but between the two. Sifra l. c.; Men. l. c. (another explan.) <he>כ̇ר̇ מ̇ל̇א</he> rounded and full.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 3:6:5">Y. Succ. III, 53ᵈ</cite> <he>כשעוה וכשושנת כ׳</he> of the color of wax or of the lily of Carmel (v. <cite ref="J00667"><he>יְרַקְרַק</he></cite>); (<cite ref="Tosefta Negaim 1:5">Tosef. Neg. I, 5</cite> <he>כשעוה וכקורמל</he>, Var. <he>וכקורמן</he>; R. S. to <cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 11:4">Neg. XI, 4</cite> <he>וכקורמין</he>).—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:1:13">Y. Ber. I, 2ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>ראש הר הכ׳</he>; <cite ref="Shabbat 35a:6">Sabb. 35ᵃ</cite> <he>ראש הכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>ראש הר הכ׳</he>) the summit of M. C.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 99">Gen. R. s. 99</cite>; Mekh. Yithro, Baḥod., s. 5 (alluding to <cite ref="Jeremiah 46:18">Jer. XLVI, 18</cite>) <he>תבור … וכ׳ מאספמיא</he> Tabor came (to the desert for the law-giving) from Beth-Elim and C. from Ispamia; <cite ref="Megillah 29a">Meg. 29ᵃ</cite>
